ICS 77.140.80

1 SCOPE
This standard covers the requirements for bauxite sand for use in foundries.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions, which through references in this text constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
